description: Documentation about returning responses directly in FastAPI, including details on Response classes, jsonable_encoder, and custom responses. It explains how FastAPI handles different types of responses, how to use Response objects directly, and considerations for serialization and documentation.

classes.name: Response
classes.description: Base class for all HTTP responses returned by FastAPI.

classes.name: JSONResponse
classes.description: A Response class that returns JSON-encoded data.

methods.name: jsonable_encoder
methods.description: Converts data types like datetime, UUID, etc., into JSON-compatible types.
